quest.title: Visitors From the Stars
quest.description: You learn Columbina's location through the terminal at The Eye of Ibni-Belum. She might be at the next facility...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x400, Primogem x50, Mora x30000, Hero's Wit x5, Mystic Enhancement Ore x4

talks.objective: Get on the high-speed transit lane

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Eggie, {NICKNAME}'s beaten those monsters! How are things on your end?

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: This is... Project Moongazer...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Is that recorded in this one, too?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What does the terminal say?

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: Nothing about the project... but there's a supplementary note...

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: "To my mentors, Ungien and his beloved Maagees-Geti — your contributions to Project Moongazer shall not be forgotten."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Sounds like something an Akademiya student would write...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: "To Mr. Alhaitham — thank you for your contributions to Paimon's studies," or something like that...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You've written a thank-you message before, Paimon?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon saw one on Alhaitham's desk! One of his students must have written it.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Then who left this message?

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: That's all it says... There are no further records...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon was hoping for more than that... Oh well. What about the power system?

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: It's fixed... I'm activating it now...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh! It worked!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh oh... Those big wheels are spinning so fast, they might suck us in! We gotta skedaddle — now!

talks.objective: Get on the high-speed transit lane
Help the kuuhenki fend off the monsters

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It looks like they're talking to each other!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You're back, Eggie! So, how'd it go? What did you guys talk about?

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: She said... she saw a girl... who walks like she's floating...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That must be Columbina! When did this happen?

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: It was a few days ago... That giant creature we just saw... was beside her...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The Mega Kuuhenki? With Columbina?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That means she must still be here! She hasn't left yet! C'mon, let's hurry inside and take a look.

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: Hmm... Let's follow the giant lifeform first... It will lead us into Ungien's Circle.

talks.objective: Follow the kuuhenki to Ungien's Circle

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, Paimon suddenly felt like a ton of bricks the moment she flew in here!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But this place sure is pretty... There's even other kuuhenki like Eggie here. It's teeming with way more life than Paimon thought...

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: Yes... Ungien's Circle is... the realm of life.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But why couldn't we see them from the outside?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: This place doesn't look like it formed naturally...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You mean someone built this place? ...Was it that Ungi-Ungi guy?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We'll probably find out when we find that terminal.

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: We should follow them...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh! Eggie's buddies are leading the way! Quick, after 'em!

talks.objective: Follow the kuuhenki to Ungien's Circle
Follow the kuuhenki to find the terminal
Follow the kuuhenki to find the terminal
Find a way to clear the Moonlit Vines

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: These are Knotted Moonlight Vines... I've seen information about them in the terminals...

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: I can show you how to clear them out...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? What did you do, Eggie?

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: Let's try that again...

talks.objective: Find a way to clear the Moonlit Vines

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Success! The terminal should be working now.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Come try it out, Eggie!

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: Hmm...

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: I activated the terminal... but... much of the data is missing...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Did those vines from earlier break something?

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: Knotted Moonlight Vines... They grow in places where the ancient moon's power has been thrown into turmoil... perhaps that's why...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is there any useful information?

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: There's a damaged engineering blueprint here...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh! ...Ugh, you can barely make it out now...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So, any news about Columbina?

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: The terminal shows... that a young girl entered this place... accompanied by a giant flying creature...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That matches what your buddies said!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Look! There's that Mega Kuuhenki again! And it's flying up that big tree...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Odds are that Columbina is over there.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's hope you're right! Come on. Next stop, that tree!

talks.objective: Advance in the direction of the large tree
Examine the inside of the trunk through the gap
Search for the path on the left

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What's going on out there?

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: The terminal records... a sea of highly concentrated ancient moon energy beneath Ungien's Circle... It provides power to the entire facility...

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: But... the leakage of this highly concentrated energy can cause storms... that will harm living beings...

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: But don't worry... this occlusion field can temporarily hold the storms back... so long as we don't exit the generator's range...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Nothing interesting on the right.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, whaddya know? There's another terminal here! And there aren't any Moonlight Vines nearby, either. Talk about a pleasant surprise.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eggie, come give this one a try. Let's see if it works!

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: Alright...

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: Terminal activated. Reading relevant information...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon has a feeling we're gonna find some unexpected intel this time!

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: Found it... a complete engineering blueprint...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, this one looks fresh off the press... Let Paimon take a closer look...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh. That stuff on the left looks just like the Ungi-Ungi Ring from the outside, but what are those two things on the right?

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: The diagram in the bottom right... That's the power hub for the entire facility... It's located underground...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Great! Looks like that's our destination... So what's this one in the top right?

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: It's the destination of the Skymount we just rode... the Space Lifeform Capture Station...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Space Lifeform Capture Station...!? Did Paimon hear that right?

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: Hmm... overall... this complex is... composed of the Ungien Biosphere and the Space Lifeform Capture Station...

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: Its designer was named... Ungien... a researcher in the field of life sciences...

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: He believed that among the stars... live many mysterious creatures we haven't discovered...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Do... those kinds of creatures really exist? Why did he want to capture them?

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: Because he wanted to overturn... Ibni-Belum's theory...

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: He believed that the deep-space signal received by the dragons... was not a message their king had sent back... but rather it came from some mysterious creature from beyond the stars...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So it all comes back to that signal...

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: Yes... To that end, he built the capture station in the space above Ungien's Circle...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What a crazy idea! So, was it a success?

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: I haven't found any relevant records...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We might find more intel at the capture station.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Makes sense. First off, though, we have to solve our power problem...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The blueprints say the power system's underground, so let's get moving!

talks.objective: Head underground to solve the power issue
Head underground to solve the power issue
Head underground to solve the power issue
Head underground to solve the power issue
Check the cause of the power malfunction
Clear the vines on the second turbine

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Maggie, how's everything going?

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Hmm? Ungie's left, you say? Then let's...

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: One moment. We appear to have guests.

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, Paimon. How did you...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Columbina! It's really you this time! Finally, we've found you!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are we interrupting anything by dropping by unannounced?

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Of course not. I'm glad to see you. I'd go so far as to call this a pleasant surprise.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe. What did Paimon say?

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Still, how did you get to the moon?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It's a long story.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You tell Columbina about how you accidentally wound up flying to the moon in a spaceship.

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Hehe, I suppose that's the moon's gravity for you. It was even able to pull your journey into its orbit.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon wouldn't have stumbled into this situation if it weren't for Eggie being so confusing...

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Uh, Eggie... Is that your name now?

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: My name is... Ninnin...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: She's Ninnin, aka Eggie.

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Please don't blame her, Paimon. I, too, am partly responsible for this.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, Paimon was just kidding... But why would you say that? What exactly happened between you two, anyway?

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Let me see... Hmm... After returning to the moon, I had an idea.

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: I wanted to tidy this place up and then invite my friends to come visit.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So, you were going to throw a moon party!

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Yes. So I spread my power throughout the moon, checking every corner to make sure it was safe.

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Soon, I discovered some things I did not understand. Ninnin was one of them. I still don't know what she and her kind are.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eggie? Isn't she a kuuhenki? Y'know, just a slightly different color...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, a completely different color... But that's no big deal, right?

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Hmm... I'd say their origins are different. The ones we see in Teyvat are born from my kuuvahki.

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: But the power flowing through the bodies of the kuuhenki here comes from a moon of an earlier era.

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Beyond that, there are other things hidden within Ninnin's body, which have... nothing to do with the moon.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Nothing to do with the moon? No wonder you said she isn't a kuuhenki...

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Maybe this is what caused her kind to develop such unique behaviors.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What kind of behaviors?

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: I discovered Ninnin in an underground forest. She was very weak and unconscious at the time. I tried to heal her with kuuvahki, but to little avail.

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: After bringing her back to the surface, I found that she began subconsciously consuming her kin — only then did she slowly awaken.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, she ate her own kind!?

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Yes... Kuuhenki would never do this. I believe only certain Abyssal creatures would... but the power that flows through Ninnin does not derive from the Abyss.

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: I... consumed others of my kind? I... don't remember...

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: You weren't fully conscious at that time.

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: And perhaps I should use the word "merge." They gave themselves to help awaken you. Hmm, yes, that sounds less like a horror story.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, Paimon's still a bit uneasy!

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Yes, I had my concerns as well, so I brought her back to Silvermoon Hall to keep her away from her kin for the time being.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So you did that to isolate her... But what about the regular kuuhenki? What if Eggie started absorbing them?

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Don't worry, that only happens between Ninnin and her own kind.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: But why did she take your form?

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: I lent her my power so the Frostmoon Scions wouldn't worry if they suddenly discovered a black kuuhenki but couldn't find me.

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Though I didn't expect you to come back here.

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: I am sorry... but... I must reclaim my mission.

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: I don't know what your mission is, I'm afraid. But if the moon's gravity has brought you back here, perhaps I can help.

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: You said that she can absorb the power of the ancient moon from the terminals in the ruins. That seems like a safe approach.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, yeah! We ran into other kuuhenki like Eggie on our way here, too, but we didn't see any of that eating-her-own-kind stuff.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Could it be because the power of the ancient moon in the terminal was enough to keep her full?

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: That sounds likely.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That said, Eggie couldn't absorb anything from the terminal at the entrance to Ungien's Circle because it was being affected by the moon's power. Was that your doing, Columbina?

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: No, that's due to the upheaval in the lunar sea. It kicked off an Archaeolune Storm, which in turn spread highly concentrated ancient moon energy all the way here.

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: As it happens, I'm on my way to take care of that. Otherwise, this power will cause harm to all living beings other than kuuhenki.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That won't do! Paimon still wants to attend your moon party!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's the matter with the lunar sea?

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Maggie.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You mean the Mega Kuuhenki we saw earlier!

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Mmhmm. Her name's Maggie, and the lunar sea is her home. It's thanks to that high concentration of energy that she's taken her current form. She has a companion there as well, named Ungie.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh? So there are two Mega Kuuhenki!?

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Yes, but Ungie's been very irritable lately. He got into a fight with Maggie, the aftershocks of which stirred up the lunar sea and caused the storm.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Oh dear. Companions are supposed to get along, not fight. Take {NICKNAME} and Paimon, for instance. We never fight about anything.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I care for the young.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: I respect my elders.

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Hehe, and you are great teachers. I've learned a lot from you about getting along with friends.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe, in that case, leave this to us! We'll get those Mega Kuuhenki to make up.

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: That alone won't be enough, unfortunately. The Archaeolune Storm has already formed.

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: So I plan to extract the Ancient Moon's Fount at the center of the lunar sea, which lies at the heart of the energy storm.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ooh, and that will not only calm the storm, but also prevent further problems even if they start fighting again?

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: I believe so, yes.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Alrighty then. When do we head out? The sooner we solve this problem, the sooner we can help Eggie. Paimon really wants to know what her mission is!

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: I had been monitoring Ungie's movements before you arrived.

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: If we want to avoid hurting him, it might be best if we wait for him to leave before retrieving the Ancient Moon's Fount. Then, we can look to help him and Maggie mend fences.

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Maggie told me that she can't detect Ungie's energy fluctuations at the moment. That means he must have gone somewhere else.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Wait. Aren't we wasting time dawdling around here, then?

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Not to worry. We can still make it in time if we leave right away.

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: Please wait...

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Hmm?

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: I want to... ask her a question...

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Maggie? Sure. But she might not be able to answer you very well.

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: Maggie... Hello... My name is Ninnin...

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: Is yours... Maagees-Geti?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Maagees-Geti? Wait a minute... isn't that the name from the terminal just now?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Ungien's lover, yes.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So she turned into a Mega Kuuhenki!? What's going on? Then the second one... Ungie... Could that be...

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: I don't know what to make of this either... but that's most likely Ungien...

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: What's wrong? You look shocked.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You tell Columbina about the information you discovered in the terminal.

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Two Dragon researchers... and Project Moongazer...?

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Hmm... It seems my home has secrets that even I know nothing about.

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Come with me for now. Once we resolve the issue of the Archaeolune Storm, we might be able to speak to Ungie.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Okay, let's go!

talks.objective: Clear the vines on the third turbine
Head for the next safe occlusion field
Activate the terminal and restart the power engine
Protect Eggie while she reads the terminal
Use the emergency passageway to return to the surface

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: You leave the engine and return safely to the surface...
